legend: Deep within a forest lies an ancient tree, home to n$$$n$$$ ants living in n$$$n$$$ tiny houses, indexed from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$, connected by the branches of the tree.
Once a year, all the ants need to gather to watch the EUC. For this, all ants move along the n−1$$$n-1$$$ branches of the tree they live on to meet at the home of one ant.

However, this year the ants could not agree on where to meet and need your help to gather up. You can tell all the ants currently at house u$$$u$$$ to move to house v$$$v$$$ if there is a branch directly connecting those two houses. However, the ants ignore your command if there are fewer ants gathered in house v$$$v$$$ than in house u$$$u$$$, i.e., if it would be easier for the ants from house v$$$v$$$ to move. This even holds true if no ant at all is currently in house v$$$v$$$. You can give this kind of commands as many times as you want.
Is it possible for you to gather all the ants in a single house?
input: The first line contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤200000$$$1\leq n\leq 200\,000$$$) — the number of ant homes.

Each of the following n−1$$$n-1$$$ lines contains two integers u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤n$$$1\leq u, v\leq n$$$) — there is a branch directly connecting the house u$$$u$$$ and house v$$$v$$$. It is guaranteed that every ant can reach the house of any other ant just by following the branches of the tree.
output: Print YES$$$\texttt{YES}$$$ if it is possible to gather all the ants in a single house. Otherwise, print NO$$$\texttt{NO}$$$.
note: In the first sample, you can gather all the ants at house 3$$$3$$$ as follows:
You tell to the ant at house 4$$$4$$$ to move to house 6$$$6$$$.
You tell to the ant at house 2$$$2$$$ to move to house 3$$$3$$$.
You tell to the two ants at house 6$$$6$$$ to move to house 3$$$3$$$ (which already contains two ants).
You tell to the ant at house 5$$$5$$$ to move to house 1$$$1$$$.
You tell to the ant at house 7$$$7$$$ to move to house 1$$$1$$$ (which already contains two ants).
You tell to the three ants at house 1$$$1$$$ to move to house 3$$$3$$$ (which already contains four ants).
In the second sample, it is impossible to gather all the ants in a single house.

legend.ai: 在森林深处，有一棵古老的树，n$$$n$$$ 只蚂蚁居住在 n$$$n$$$ 间小屋中，这些小屋编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$，并由树的树枝连接起来。
每年一次，所有蚂蚁都需要聚集起来观看 EUC。为此，所有蚂蚁沿着它们所居住的树上的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条边移动，在某只蚂蚁的家中集合。

然而，今年蚂蚁们无法就集合地点达成一致，需要你的帮助来聚集。你可以告诉当前位于房屋 u$$$u$$$ 的所有蚂蚁移动到房屋 v$$$v$$$，前提是这两栋房屋之间有一条直接相连的边。但是，如果房屋 v$$$v$$$ 中聚集的蚂蚁少于房屋 u$$$u$$$ 中的蚂蚁，也就是说，如果让来自房屋 v$$$v$$$ 的蚂蚁移动会更容易，蚂蚁们就会无视你的命令。即使房屋 v$$$v$$$ 中当前一只蚂蚁都没有，这一规则仍然适用。你可以任意多次发出这类命令。
你能否将所有蚂蚁聚集在同一所房屋中？

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤200000$$$1\leq n\leq 200\,000$$$) ——蚂蚁房屋的数量。
接下来的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 行中的每一行包含两个整数 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤n$$$1\leq u, v\leq n$$$) ——存在一条边直接连接房屋 u$$$u$$$ 和房屋 v$$$v$$$。保证每只蚂蚁都可以仅沿着树的边到达任意其他蚂蚁所在的房屋。

output.ai: 如果可以将所有蚂蚁聚集在同一所房屋中，输出 YES$$$\texttt{YES}$$$。否则，输出 NO$$$\texttt{NO}$$$。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，你可以按如下方式将所有蚂蚁聚集到房屋 3$$$3$$$：
你让位于房屋 4$$$4$$$ 的蚂蚁移动到房屋 6$$$6$$$。
你让位于房屋 2$$$2$$$ 的蚂蚁移动到房屋 3$$$3$$$。
你让位于房屋 6$$$6$$$ 的两只蚂蚁移动到房屋 3$$$3$$$(其中已经有两只蚂蚁)。
你让位于房屋 5$$$5$$$ 的蚂蚁移动到房屋 1$$$1$$$。
你让位于房屋 7$$$7$$$ 的蚂蚁移动到房屋 1$$$1$$$(其中已经有两只蚂蚁)。
你让房屋 1$$$1$$$ 中的三只蚂蚁移动到房屋 3$$$3$$$(那里已经有四只蚂蚁)。
在第二个样例中，不可能将所有蚂蚁聚集在同一所房屋中。
